summary.text: Kim Kendall is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 18, elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Kendall is a former Federal Aviation Administration air traffic controller, has a bachelor's degree from Florida State University, and lives in St. Augustine.
Kendall was born in Arlington, Virginia, and moved to Florida in 1976.
